# Feature ablation (ZR-2)

*Generated by `bench/ablation.py` from `bench/results/ablation.json` — do not edit by hand.*

Spark 4.1.3 · estimator gbt (defaults) · 1000 bootstrap resamples · generated 2026-09-26T15:56:36.

Each corpus computes the full comparison vector once; every row trains the default estimator on a subset of its columns, picks the threshold on VALID and reports TEST. The **reference** row is the default feature set (candidate, edit, exact, gram, monge_elkan, phonetic, rarity, structure, token_idf); `- family` removes one family, `+ … (UDF)` adds the optional UDF features, `+ embedding …` adds the embedding cosine. Δ is the difference from the reference, with a paired bootstrap interval (same resamples): an interval that excludes 0 is a measured effect.

## Decision D12 — embeddings on by default?

Rule: D12: on by default for organisation and title fields only if the chosen model's TEST F1 difference is positive on both corpora.

Model chosen on mean VALID F1 over leipzig_affiliations and abt_buy: **minishlab/potion-base-32M**.

| Model | Mean VALID F1 | TEST Δ Leipzig | TEST Δ Abt-Buy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| minishlab/potion-base-8M | 0.7535 | +0.0059 [-0.0024, +0.0148] | +0.0196 [-0.0194, +0.0615] |
| minishlab/potion-base-32M | 0.7708 | +0.0072 [-0.0003, +0.0150] | +0.0765 [+0.0293, +0.1231] |

Verdict: the embedding feature is kept **on** by default for organisation and title fields (`features.embeddings.fields_of_type` in `config.py`).
